## Task 1 – The setup check

**In your workspace.** Run `source("R/check_setup.R")` until every line prints OK. The last check prints −19.97 percentage points. Then read the four scenarios of the warm-up in the box of Task 1 of `index.qmd`, and name the R that each scenario describes.

[Open the deck at Task 1](../../live/day.html#/hands-on-1-get-yourself-running){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"} [Open the browser lab at Task 1](../../lab.qmd#task-1-setup){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

If your installation fails, run the same cells in the deck or in the browser lab, which give the same numbers.
